clips.title: The story
paras: Journey into Thunder Bluff is the culminating pilgrimage marking the end of a young hero's trials across Mulgore. Having completed the sacred Rites of the Earthmother under the guidance of the spirits, the adventurer is granted an audience with the High Chieftain of the tauren, Cairne Bloodhoof.

Before any traveler or fledgling warrior can truly claim to have proven themselves in Mulgore, they must undergo the ancient Rites of the Earthmother. These trials test strength, vision, and wisdom across the rolling plains and ancestral sites of the land. Once the Ancestral Spirit acknowledges the final rite, the initiate is deemed worthy of entering the city of Thunder Bluff not as a mere visitor, but as an honored defender of the tauren people.

The quest directs the traveler from the sacred ground where the spirits wander straight to the towering heights of Thunder Bluff. Perched atop the mesas, the city is a beacon of peace carved from red stone and supported by sweeping rope bridges and massive wooden elevators. There, on the High Rise, High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof awaits to personally greet those who have walked the path of the ancestors.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You will now be revered within our great city. Any traveler worthy of completing the Rites of the Earthmother earns that honor.
For your final quest, seek out our noble leader, Cairne Bloodhoof, who dwells atop the highest mesa in Thunder Bluff.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hail, young adventurer. I see you found your way to my doorstep.
